Sanguine Slumber 1.0.3
======================

SKSE plugin for Skyrim (SE 1.5.97 / AE 1.6.x - 1.7.x / VR).
Every night's sleep carries a small chance of waking up with Sanguinare Vampiris - higher in
the wild than in town. Optionally, Vampiric Drain can be stopped from spreading it (off by default).

Source code
-----------
The complete source code for this release is available at:
  https://github.com/eargsm/SanguineSlumber   (tag v1.0.2)

Contents
--------
  SKSE/Plugins/SanguineSlumber.dll   the plugin
  SKSE/Plugins/SanguineSlumber.ini   settings (also editable in game via SKSE Menu Framework)
  SKSE/Plugins/SanguineSlumber.pdb   debug symbols for crash loggers (optional)
  LICENSE.txt                        GNU General Public License, version 3 (full text)
  EXCEPTIONS.txt                     additional permissions for modding libraries
  README.txt                         this file

Requirements
------------
  SKSE64 (or SKSE VR)
  Address Library for SKSE Plugins
  Optional: SKSE Menu Framework, for the in-game settings page

Third-party code
----------------
  CommonLibSSE-NG (https://github.com/alandtse/CommonLibSSE-NG) - GPL-3.0
  SKSE Menu Framework consumer header (QTR-Modding/SKSE-Menu-Framework-3-Example) - MIT
